title: Triad
summary: TRI'AD, noun [Latin trias, from tres, three.] The union of three; three united. In music, the common chord or harmony, consisting of the third, fifth and eighth.

inlines.v: TRI'AD, noun [Latin trias, from tres, three.] The union of three; three united. In music, the common chord or harmony, consisting of the third, fifth and eighth.
